discrepancy.detail: The frozen config and gate2 execution metrics record adaptation_batch_size=64 as the successful candidate batch. The actual DataLoader batch is min(64, len(dataset)); therefore it is 1 for the 1-day budget and 49 for the 3-day budget. Treating the recorded 64 as the physical loader batch for those budgets would be incorrect.
discrepancy.effect_on_existing_predictions_or_result: No. The predictions were generated by the dynamic DataLoader rule in the audited code. This affects manuscript/config interpretation, not the completed numerical outputs.
discrepancy.other_conflicts: None identified for loss functions, source batch 256, Adam learning rates, 50 adaptation epochs, shuffle behavior, drop_last behavior, or head-only parameter updates. Existing narrative reports do not directly state the loss class or the dynamic adaptation batch rule.
